snippet.title: HARD VOID Demo trailer
snippet.description:
HARD VOID Demo gameplay trailer for update v0.7.2!
Hi, I am jejoxdev, a solo indiedev working on my project HARD VOID.

HARD VOID is a Retro-style Lovecraft-inspired 4X space turn-based strategy game.

Lead your custom species across galaxies and multiple dimensions to build an Empire. Design your spaceships, assemble your fleets, and fight for supremacy. But beware, unthinkable Eldritch horrors lurk in the vast darkness.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2978460/HARD_VOID/
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/jejoxdev/hard-void
https://hardvoid.com/

Wishlist on Steam!
Follow in Kickstarter!
